root: ^A sword? You against the bear? He lets out a short, humorless chuckle before tossing a sword onto the counter. Fine. Take it. Not like it’ll do you much good. Just try not to die.
^I’ll be needing that sword back after you’re done with whatever stupid idea you have in mind. Despite his words, there’s the slightest trace of concern in his voice.
^... make sure not to die before solving this. I won't forgive you if you do. He signs the chest behind him. Is inside of it.
